semantic.justification: Task6764KT extracts the actual SvxStyleBox SetFont/SetFontSize/SetFontStyle operations. Real SfxItemSet slot mapping and inherited/default state determine admission;unknown,disabled and invalid states preserve the recipient. Font name assignment deliberately copies only family/style names,not the other FontItem metadata. Posture precedes weight and each slot is independent. Size uses the absolute item height through an actual caller-owned device conversion and current shell map unit;absence of a shell returns false and no CSS DPI is guessed. These are extracted value operations over the shared Font base,not a partial SvxFont or SvxStyleBox class. Full SetupEntry decorations/colors,EditEngine CheckScript,physical face selection,Canvas row integration and native widget services remain unfinished. No whole-module parity promotion.
